title: xv6 kernel extensions
description: Extensions to the educational xv6 RISC-V kernel, exploring processes, memory, and system calls.
results: Worked at kernel level to understand process scheduling, memory management, and system calls
Modified and extended OS components to explore core operating system behaviors
Gained practical experience with low-level programming and hardware-software interaction
Strengthened understanding of concurrency, process lifecycle, and system resource management
proof: Hands-on work with process lifecycle and kernel components.
